BrochureContent.Content: A superbly appointed Period home, located on sought after Garville Avenue, offering  bright and well-proportioned accommodation c.400  sq. m currently divided into six large pre ’63 apartments (4 x 2 bed & 2 x 1 bed) enriched with beautiful features throughout. The subdivision has been careful to respect  the integrity of the house, retaining many of its original features including original marble fireplaces, window casings, high ceilings decorated with elaborate covings, panel doors and  original staircase etc. The property includes generous gardens – the front nicely set back from the street while the low maintenance rear garden enjoys vehicular access. No 42 offers excellent potential to generate an immediate and substantial rental income or indeed reinstate into an impressive family home. The location is second to none being within walking distance of Rathgar with it neighbourhood shopping, vibrant cafés, restaurants and bars. The area is well served with frequent buses providing fast and convenient access to the city centre, early viewing is highly recommended.

Outside 
The property is nicely set back from the road (10.5m) behind traditional wrought iron railings, the front door is approached via granite steps. The garden is finished in gravel planted with seasonal flowers and shrubs. The rear garden extends approx. 25 meters from the house with vehicular access from Garville Lane. The garden is set out in low maintenance tarmacadam and provides ample off street parking. The rear offers excellent potential to reinstate a lawn area to provide additional amenity space.
